source.prompt: Afro house song, about 3.5 minutes, 121 BPM, G minor. Warm, rolling, hypnotic sunset-by-the-river mood. Smooth, soulful female lead vocal, intimate in the verses, rising and warm on the chorus with soft harmonies. Soft mallet marimba and kalimba melodies played gently, warm Rhodes electric piano chords, airy analog pads, a smooth legato flute lead, deep round sub bass. Four-on-the-floor kick, soft claps, shakers, gentle congas and bongos, light rimshots; no harsh transients, no glitch effects, no hard plucks. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal and Rhodes, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, smooth, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[verse]
Evening folds across the town
Lanterns waking one by one
I walk barefoot to the shore
Where the river meets the sun

[pre-chorus]
Slow it down, let it flow
Everything I need is here
Let it go, let it go

[chorus]
Amber over water
Gold is falling soft and slow
Amber over water
Hold me where the warm winds go
Amber over water

[verse]
Drums are calling from the hill
Voices rising with the tide
Every heartbeat keeping time
With the fire deep inside

[pre-chorus]
Slow it down, let it flow
Everything I need is here
Let it go, let it go

[chorus]
Amber over water
Gold is falling soft and slow
Amber over water
Hold me where the warm winds go
Amber over water

[bridge]
When the night comes in
And the colors fade
I will keep this light
Like a song I made

[chorus]
Amber over water

Amber over water
Hold me where the warm winds go
Amber over water
